title: CROS ReplayRecord
description: Stage 7 of 7. The outcome of attempting to re-execute from a RenderEvidence. Terminal artifact. A ReplayRecord records an attempt and its verdict — 'unverified' is a legitimate, honest verdict and is the correct value when no replay was actually run.

replayClass.description: CI-005: must be permitted by the active profile. Must not exceed the class asserted by the evidence being replayed.

verdict.description: 'reproduced' means equality held at the strength defined by replayClass — not stronger. 'unverified' means no attempt was made.

inputs.description: The inputs actually re-submitted, copied from evidence.replay.inputs.

comparison.description: Class-appropriate comparison detail: byte equality for bit-identical, parameter diff for deterministic-parameters, provider response metadata for provider-contract.
